jobs.description: Start your technical career in the Netherlands Are you an experienced Maintenance Technician based in Portugal and ready for an international step in your career? Xelvin is looking for motivated technical professionals who want to relocate to the Netherlands and work in industrial maintenance, production technology or technical service environments. In this role, you will work as part of a technical department and help keep machines, production lines and installations running smoothly. You will solve technical issues, carry out preventive maintenance and contribute to a safe, reliable and efficient production process. This position is suitable for technicians with experience in industrial maintenance, mechanics, electromechanics, automation or technical service. What you will do As a Maintenance Technician, you are responsible for maintaining, repairing and improving technical installations and production equipment. You will work in a practical, hands-on environment where no two days are the same. Your responsibilities may include: Performing preventive and corrective maintenance on machines, production lines and technical installations. Diagnosing mechanical, electrical, pneumatic or hydraulic faults. Repairing and replacing machine parts, sensors, motors, pumps, conveyors or other technical components. Supporting production teams when technical problems occur. Carrying out inspections and basic testing of equipment. Reading and using technical drawings, electrical diagrams or machine documentation. Registering maintenance activities and technical findings. Thinking along about improvements in reliability, safety and efficiency. Working according to safety standards and company procedures. Cooperating with colleagues from production, engineering and technical service. Depending on your experience, the role can be more mechanically, electrically or electromechanically focused. What Xelvin offers you Relocating to another country is a big step. Xelvin supports youthroughout the process, from the first interview to your first working day in the Netherlands. We offer: A full-time job with long-term perspective in the Netherlands. A competitive gross monthly salary between €2,800 and €4,200, depending on your experience, technical background and the type of company. Possible shift allowance, depending on the working schedule and production environment. 25 paid holidays, in addition to Dutch public holidays. 8.33% holiday allowance. Pension arrangement. Support with your relocation from Portugal to the Netherlands. Assistance with documentation needed to work in the Netherlands. Guidance from our housing consultant in finding accommodation. Support during onboarding and your first period in the Netherlands. Personal guidance from Xelvin. Opportunities for training, courses and career development. What you bring For the Portuguese market, we are looking for practical technicians with a solid technical education and hands-on experience in an industrial environment. You have: A technical education such as Curso Técnico Profissional / Nível 4 or higher in one of the following areas: Mecatrónica Manutenção Industrial Eletromecânica Eletrotecnia Automação Mecânica Industrial Technology or similar At least 2 years of experience in industrial maintenance, technical service, production maintenance or machine maintenance. Good mechanical and/or electrical troubleshooting skills. Experience with industrial equipment, production lines, machinery or automated systems. Basic knowledge of electrical, mechanical, pneumatic or hydraulic systems. The ability to read technical drawings or electrical schematics is a strong advantage. Experience with PLC-controlled machinery is a plus, but not always required. A practical, hands-on mindset. A safe and responsible way of working. Xelvin is looking for an experienced Production Test Engineer with a strong Electrical Engineering background to join the engineering team of a leading technology company in Eindhoven. In this role, you will develop and implement production test solutions for advanced electronic systems, ensuring products meet the highest quality standards before entering serial production. As a Production Test Engineer, you will play a key role in bridging product development and manufacturing by designing, developing and maintaining production test solutions. You will work closely with hardware, embedded software and manufacturing teams to ensure products can be efficiently and reliably tested throughout their lifecycle. Your responsibilities include: Developing production test strategies and test sequences for electronic products. Designing test hardware, including PCB-based test interfaces, fixtures and measurement circuits. Developing and maintaining automated test software using Python and C++. Performing Design for Testability (DfT) reviews during product development. Designing and maintaining automated production test setups. Supporting New Product Introduction (NPI) activities. Performing root cause analysis on production and test failures. Improving test coverage, production yield, reliability and manufacturing efficiency.
